scenario.title: ROAD TO VIENNA - 3 APR 1945
intro.text:
ROAD TO VIENNA - 3 APR 1945

East of Vienna, Austria

The Germans are on the run - withdrawing towards Vienna. Chase the enemy and destroy as many units as possible so that the enemy cannot establish an effective line of defense in front of Vienna!

ORDERS
a. Capture all VH!
b. Prevent that more than 44 enemy ground units reach the Exit Points.

NOTES
Attention summer conditions! Don't forget to switch back to wheeled movement, if wanted.
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-briliant.text: The German armour east of Balaton was caught before it could recover from its failed offensive. Interrogations describe fuel shortages more often than Soviet fire.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-victory.text: The Balaton counterattack cleared the objectives and forced the German armour west. Enough escaped to stiffen the roads ahead of Vienna.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-tactical.text: We won at Balaton after the enemy had begun disengaging. The battlefield is ours; much of the armour that matters is already on the roads west.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.callback-choice-a.text: You attacked at Balaton before the recovery crews cleared the roads. We caught tanks without fuel and left some of our own behind for want of the same thing.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: The refit at Balaton gave us a coherent counterattack. It also gave the German rear guards the night they needed to begin this withdrawal.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.earned-decision.text: The early finish at Balaton left a reserve train unused and the recovery parks ahead of schedule. We can release one new machine detachment or use the capacity to restore the whole group.
line.earned-decision.choice.release-zsu3: Release the new self-propelled antiaircraft detachment for the Vienna roads.
Add an experienced eight-strength ZSU-37 detachment to the core.
line.earned-decision.choice.expand-recov: Use the reserve train to recover and replenish every existing formation.
Restore the entire core to full strength, fuel, and ammunition and give every formation 12 experience.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.earned-a-response.text: The columns gain protection against air attack without waiting for towed guns to unlimber. It is a small formation, but it can remain with the spearhead.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.earned-b-response.text: Then the train carries replacements instead of a new unit. The strength return will look less exciting and the army behind it more complete.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: Interrogation reports agree on one fact: every road west is crowded. They disagree on which columns are combat units, refugees, forced labourers, or headquarters. Air reconnaissance sees movement but not intent.
line.decision.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.decision.text: We can drive mobile groups through the retreat and close the exits, or secure the supply roads so the pursuit arrives at Vienna with artillery and fuel enough to continue.
line.decision.choice.cut-the-retreat.tex: Send mobile groups for the western exits and force the retreating columns to surrender or disperse.
line.decision.choice.cut-the-retreat.hin: Fully refuel the core, give tank and reconnaissance formations 25 experience each, and gain 120 prestige for closing the retreat routes.
line.decision.choice.secure-the-road.tex: Clear the road network in sequence and keep artillery and supply inside the advance.
line.decision.choice.secure-the-road.hin: Attach an eight-strength 1943 engineer detachment with 60 experience and restore the core to nine strength with full supply; road work costs 100 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: The mobile groups identify military columns before engaging and leave marked lanes for civilians. Their purpose is to prevent another defence, not turn every road into a battlefield.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-a-1.text: Leave marked lanes before the first tank closes a road. Refugees and forced labourers do not become military traffic because our timetable cannot distinguish them.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-b-0.text: Traffic control becomes part of the attack. Every captured junction receives engineers and guards before the leading guns move through it.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-b-1.text: Then some German columns will escape among the traffic. I will keep their last known positions on the board, so an orderly road does not become an orderly report of victory.
line.post-0.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.post-0.text: Put the traffic categories on cards large enough for a turret crew to read. If we cannot tell them apart from here, we do not leave the decision to a trigger finger.
